mapper.select: SELECT user_id, username, money, game_time, game_date, difficulty FROM userinfo WHERE user_id = #{userId} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO userinfo (user_id, username, money, game_time, game_date, difficulty) VALUES (#{userId}, #{username}, #{money}, #{gameTime}, #{gameDate}, #{difficulty})
mapper.update: UPDATE userinfo SET money = #{money}, game_time = #{gameTime}, game_date = #{gameDate}, difficulty = #{difficulty}, username = #{username} WHERE user_id = #{userId}
UPDATE userinfo SET game_date = #{gameDate} WHERE user_id = #{userId}
UPDATE userinfo SET game_time = #{gameTime} WHERE user_id = #{userId}
UPDATE userinfo SET money = #{money} WHERE user_id = #{userId}
